name: SurveyMonkey
description_en:
SurveyMonkey is a hosted service for creating, distributing and analyzing surveys. The site combines questionnaire templates, logic, analysis, collaboration and optional access to a research panel. Its navigation also names LaunchPad, Apply, GetFeedback and Wufoo; these adjacent products should not all be treated as included survey features.

A meaningful comparison depends on seats, response allowances, logic and data access after a plan ends. The public pricing page retrieved for this research was localized in Singapore dollars. Those amounts are a regional snapshot, not a global USD quote.
description_zh:
SurveyMonkey 是创建、分发及分析问卷的托管服务，结合模板、逻辑、分析、协作，以及可另购的研究样本。导航另列 LaunchPad、Apply、GetFeedback 和 Wufoo，不能把这些相邻产品都视为问卷套餐包含功能。

比较时需结合席位、回答额度、逻辑和套餐结束后的数据访问。本次读取的公开价格页采用新加坡元，因此只是地区快照，不能作为全球美元报价。

core_features.explanation_en: Build questionnaires and analyze returned responses within the chosen edition.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在所选版本内创建问卷并分析收到的回答。

core_features.explanation_en: Team plans provide roles, shared assets and pooled response allowances.
core_features.explanation_zh: 团队套餐提供角色、共享资产及合并回答额度。

en: Run a collaborative concept questionnaire with an explicit audience budget.
zh: 在明确受众预算下协作开展概念问卷。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Confirm local currency, minimum seats, response period and the individual versus team edition before creating a pilot survey.
steps.zh: 创建试点前确认当地币种、人数下限、回答周期及个人或团队版本。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Regional per-seat subscription, pooled response allowances, response and seat overage; panel purchases separate.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Localized SGD snapshot: Team Advantage SGD 49/user/month, annual and minimum three users; Premier SGD 115 with same minimum. Annual allowances 50,000/100,000; SGD 0.10 per extra response. Audience responses sold separately. Enterprise is quoted, minimum five users. Individual prices and Basic visible-response limits were not resolved.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 新加坡元地区快照：Team Advantage 年付折合每人每月 SGD 49、至少 3 人；Premier SGD 115、相同人数下限，年度回答分别 50,000/100,000；超额每条 SGD 0.10。Audience 回答另售。Enterprise 询价且至少 5 人。个人版价格和 Basic 可见回答额度未确定。

sources.research_notes_en: Hosted questionnaire platform; LaunchPad, Apply, GetFeedback and Wufoo are separately named products.

sources.title: SurveyMonkey Plans and Pricing
sources.research_notes_en: Retrieved localized Singapore-dollar team pricing, minimum seats, pooled annual response allowances, paid overage and Basic downgrade retention warning.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Separate the questionnaire from the audience purchase
sections.title_zh: 把问卷与受众采购分开
sections.en: SurveyMonkey provides survey creation and analysis, but the pricing footnote explicitly sells SurveyMonkey Audience responses separately. An illustrative concept survey needs both a questionnaire and a recruitment plan. Publishing a link does not produce a qualified or representative audience by itself. AI analysis and templates help prepare or organize work; their presence is not evidence of a valid study or independently accurate interpretation.
sections.zh: SurveyMonkey 提供问卷创建与分析，但价格脚注明确说明 Audience 回答另售。例如概念调查既要有问卷，也要有招募计划。发布链接不会自动带来合格或有代表性的样本。AI 分析和模板帮助准备或整理，不能证明研究有效或解释已独立验证。

sections.title_en: Apply the team minimum before comparing unit prices
sections.title_zh: 比较单价前先计算团队下限
sections.en: The retrieved Team Advantage view lists SGD 49 per user per month billed annually, starting at three users, with 50,000 responses per year. Team Premier lists SGD 115 on the same per-user annual basis with 100,000 yearly responses. At three Advantage seats, the illustrative annual subscription arithmetic is SGD 1,764 before other charges. Enterprise starts at five users with a custom limit and quote. These are localized conditions, not universal pricing.
sections.zh: 本次 Team Advantage 视图为每人每月 SGD 49、年付且至少 3 人，含每年 50,000 条回答；Team Premier 相同按人年付口径为 SGD 115，含每年 100,000 条。按 3 位 Advantage 席位算，年度订阅为 SGD 1,764，未含其他收费。Enterprise 至少 5 人，容量及价格定制。这些是地区条件，不是统一全球价格。

sections.title_en: Responses and extra collaborators can both create charges
sections.title_zh: 回答和额外协作者都可能产生费用
sections.en: The pricing FAQ counts paid response limits across all surveys and users and lists SGD 0.10 for each additional response in this view. Full Access and Analyst seats have different capabilities, and inviting more people than purchased seats can create prorated overage. Accounts are individual and cannot be shared; the page describes up to two registered devices per user. Count people, not just simultaneous logins.
sections.zh: 价格 FAQ 说明付费回答限额合并计算所有问卷与用户，本视图超额每条 SGD 0.10。Full Access 与 Analyst 权限不同，邀请人数超过购买席位可能产生按比例费用。账户仅供个人使用、不能共享，页面说明每人最多注册两台设备。应按人员而不是同时登录数计算席位。

sections.title_en: Include the end of the subscription in the data plan
sections.title_zh: 把订阅结束后的数据安排纳入计划
sections.en: Auto-renew is enabled by default. Turning it off downgrades at the end of the cycle; the page warns that responses beyond Basic’s allowance older than 365 days are deleted under the retention policy. Basic’s exact visible-response allowance is shown at signup or login rather than established by this retrieved page. Export what is required while entitled and confirm retention before downgrade. No deletion or recovery was tested.
sections.zh: 默认开启自动续费。关闭后在账期结束降级；页面警告，超过 Basic 额度且早于 365 天的回答会按保留政策删除。Basic 可见回答的准确额度在注册或登录时显示，本次页面未确定。应在具备权益时完成必要导出，并在降级前确认保留规则。本文未测试删除或恢复。

sections.title_en: Verify the exact edition and data requirements
sections.title_zh: 核对准确版本与数据要求
sections.en: SurveyMonkey is a candidate for teams needing questionnaire collaboration and analysis with a managed service. A small one-off questionnaire should compare Basic or the separately mentioned monthly Standard option rather than assume a three-seat team purchase is necessary. No precise individual price, self-hosted server or open-source license was verified. The attempted help URL returned 404, so detailed configuration, export and recovery procedures remain research gaps.
sections.zh: 团队需要托管问卷协作及分析时，可以考虑 SurveyMonkey。小型一次性问卷应比较 Basic 或页面另提的月付 Standard，不必先假设需要购买 3 人团队套餐。本次未确认个人版准确价格、自托管服务端或开源许可。尝试的帮助链接返回 404，详细配置、导出与恢复流程仍是缺口。

research_gaps: No survey builder, branching, collaboration, delivery, analysis, export or downgrade was executed.
Individual prices, Basic response limit, exact plan feature entitlements, residency/retention contract, source license and self-hosting remain unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
